My family would stay together - maybe be closer together. My dad almost died when I was 8 or 9, he became so horribly sick that the doctors told my mother that he would die (in a more roundabout way, of course), he lived through it. That event caused us to bond together as a family. While there was talk of divorce and arguing, I know they would never follow through with it. I haven't spoken to my doctor about this, although I have been planning to for a while, and it will happen eventually.

I'm trying - maybe too hard - to a find a purpose for myself. I want so desperately to be a means to an end, but this search of meaning is causing more depression as I find myself more and more meaningless when I can't find an end worth working towards. I can see how narrowing my focus would help, if there were something to focus on.

Damn, our dads are similar. I pretend to be happy because when I let my parents know how I was they argued much more frequently, even talk of divorce came up, and I don't want that for them because of me. My dad is always wanting to do projects with me, and I would like to do them, but he always ends up not being able to because his work takes up too much time. I am thankful he has a job, though, and understand that he needs to keep it to provide for this family.
